prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single “best” AI video ad maker for everyone — the right choice depends on your goals, budget, format and level of polish you need. Below are top options by use case, with strengths and tradeoffs to help you pick quickly.

Quick picks by use case
- Best all-around for marketers: InVideo — large ad-template library, easy editing, good stock assets and social formats. Fast for Facebook/Instagram/TikTok ads.
- Best for AI presenter/spokesperson videos: Synthesia (or HeyGen) — realistic, lip‑synced avatars speaking your script in many languages; great for product explainers and corporate ads.
- Best for repurposing long content into short ads: Pictory or Opus Clip — automatic highlight selection, captions, and social-ready formats.
- Best for e‑commerce/social ad scale: Shakr or Promo.com — template systems built specifically for product ads and paid‑social requirements.
- Best for quick, low‑cost DIY: Canva or Biteable — easy templates, stock footage, free tiers and fast turnaround.
- Best for enterprise/creative optimization: VidMob — creative performance analytics + production scale (more expensive).
- Best for turning blog/text into video: Lumen5 — AI storyboard from text with simple editing.

What to consider when choosing
- Output quality: realism, resolution, motion smoothness.
- Format templates: vertical/horizontal/square for platforms.
- AI features: text-to-video, avatars, voice cloning, auto-captions.
- Stock assets & custom uploads: required product images/video.
- Languages & voices: needed for international campaigns.
- Scale & automation: bulk video generation, APIs, dynamic personalization.
- Integrations & workflow: ad managers, analytics, collaboration tools.
- Pricing & licensing: per‑video cost, seats, royalty-free usage.
- Trial & speed: how fast you can prototype and iterate.

How I’d recommend you choose
1. Match to a use case (social ad vs spokesperson vs dynamic personalization).  
2. Try 2–3 tools on short trials — recreate one real ad and compare time, cost, and results.  
3. Consider production + creative testing (you may need both a maker and a creative optimization tool).

If you tell me:
- platform(s) (Facebook/Instagram/TikTok/YouTube),  
- ad type (spokesperson, product demo, user testimonial, repurposed clip), and  
- budget (free/low/$$/enterprise),

I’ll recommend 2–3 specific tools and a simple test plan to pick the best one for you.
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
